```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
setwd(here::here())
```

```{r pkgs, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(IPDfromKM)
library(survival)
library(simsurv)
library(SurvdigitizeR)
library(png)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse); theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r seed}
set.seed(427)
```


```{r}
n <- 35         # 样本量
lambda <- 0.1          # 指数分布 rate

# 事件时间
time_nocens   <- rexp(n, rate = lambda)
status_nocens <- rep(1L, n)   # 全部发生事件，没有删失

fit_nocens <- survfit(Surv(time_nocens, status_nocens) ~ 1)
summary(fit_nocens)$surv[1:5]
```

```{r no_censoring}
set.seed(11)

png(here::here('test', "km_nocens.png"), width = 700, height = 700, res = 120)

plot(
  fit_nocens,
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = "Survival",
  xlim = c(0, 10),
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  mark.time = FALSE,   # 没删失，本来也没 +
  main = "No censoring"
)

dev.off()

res_nocens <- survival_digitize(
  img_path        = here::here('test', "km_nocens.png"),
  num_curves      = 1,        # 只有一条曲线
  x_start         = 0,
  x_end           = 10,
  x_increment     = 2,
  y_start         = 0,
  y_end           = 1,
  y_increment     = 0.2,
  y_text_vertical = FALSE,    # y 轴数字是横着写的
  censoring       = FALSE
)

head(res_nocens)
# 通常包含类似: times, St, curve

# 用 SurvdigitizeR 输出
km_nocens <- res_nocens   # 一条曲线，无需 subset

dat_nocens <- data.frame(
  time = km_nocens$time,
  surv = km_nocens$St * 100   # 0–1 → 0–100
)

# risk table: 我们用“真 IPD”来算，然后假装是已知的
trisk <- seq(0, 10, by = 2)
nrisk <- sapply(trisk, function(t0) sum(time_nocens >= t0))

cbind(trisk, nrisk)

pre_nocens <- preprocess(
  dat   = dat_nocens,
  trisk = trisk,
  nrisk = nrisk,
  maxy  = 100
)

est_nocens <- getIPD(
  prep       = pre_nocens,
  armID      = 1,
  tot.events = sum(status_nocens == 1)  # 这里其实 = n
)

ipd_nocens_ipdfkm <- est_nocens$IPD
head(ipd_nocens_ipdfkm)

fit_true_nocens  <- survfit(Surv(time_nocens, status_nocens) ~ 1)
fit_ipdfkm_nocens <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = ipd_nocens_ipdfkm)

plot(fit_true_nocens, col = "black", lwd = 2,
     main = "True vs IPDfromKM (no censor)")
lines(fit_ipdfkm_nocens, col = "blue", lty = 2)
legend("bottomleft", c("True", "IPDfromKM"), col=c("black","blue"),
       lty = c(1,2), lwd=2)

```

```{r}
# 保持同一个事件时间向量，更好对比
cens_max <- 10                      # 控制删失强度
cens_time <- runif(n, 0, cens_max)  # 删失时间

time_cens   <- pmin(time_nocens, cens_time)
status_cens <- as.integer(time_nocens <= cens_time)  # 1=事件, 0=删失

fit_cens <- survfit(Surv(time_cens, status_cens) ~ 1)

table(status_cens)   # 看删失比例

```

```{r censoring}
set.seed(11)

png(here::here('test', "km_cens.png"), width = 700, height = 700, res = 120)

plot(
  fit_cens,
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = "Survival",
  xlim = c(0, 10),
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  mark.time = TRUE, 
  conf.int = FALSE,
  mark      = 3, 
  main      = "With censoring"
)

dev.off()

res_cens <- survival_digitize(
  img_path        = here::here('test', "km_cens.png"),
  num_curves      = 1,
  x_start         = 0,
  x_end           = 10,
  x_increment     = 2,
  y_start         = 0,
  y_end           = 1,
  y_increment     = 0.2,
  y_text_vertical = FALSE,
  censoring       = FALSE    # 注意: 这里先只提曲线，不提 "+"
)

img1 <- readPNG(here::here("test", "km_cens.png"))
if (length(dim(img1)) == 3L) {
  img1_gray <- img1[, , 1]      # 取第一层，变成矩阵
} else {
  img1_gray <- img1
}
class(img1_gray)  # "matrix"
dim(img1_gray)

n_cens <- sum(status_cens == 0)   # 真实删失个数，只是知道要点几下

windows()
pts <- getpoints(img1_gray, x1 = 0, x2 = 10, y1 = 0, y2 = 1)

cens_times_digitized <- pts$x

ipd_kmto_cens <- KMtoIPD::getIPD(n = 35, t = res_cens$time, S = res_cens$St, cens.t = cens_times_digitized)

```


```{r}
nrow(ipd_kmto_cens)       # 重建出来有多少人
table(ipd_kmto_cens$event)  # 0=删失, 1=事件
length(time_cens)
table(status_cens)
```

```{r}
fit_kmto_cens <- survfit(Surv(t, event) ~ 1, data = ipd_kmto_cens)

plot(
  fit_cens,
  col       = "black",
  lwd       = 2,
  main      = "True vs KMtoIPD (with censoring times)",
  xlab      = "Time",
  ylab      = "Survival",
  mark.time = TRUE,
  mark      = 3,
  mark.col  = "black"
)

lines(
  fit_kmto_cens,
  col       = "red",
  lty       = 2,
  mark.time = TRUE,
  mark      = 3,
  mark.col  = "red"
)

legend("bottomleft",
       c("True", "KMtoIPD (cens)"),
       col = c("black","red"),
       lwd = 2, lty = c(1,2))

rmse_surv <- function(fit1, fit2, n_grid = 200) {
  t_max <- min(max(fit1$time), max(fit2$time))
  grid  <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = n_grid)

  s1 <- summary(fit1, times = grid)$surv
  s2 <- summary(fit2, times = grid)$surv

  ok <- !(is.na(s1) | is.na(s2))
  sqrt(mean((s1[ok] - s2[ok])^2))
}

rmse_kmto_cens <- rmse_surv(fit_cens, fit_kmto_cens)
rmse_kmto_cens
```


```{r}
dat_cens <- data.frame(
  time = res_cens$time,
  surv = res_cens$St * 100     # 转成百分比
)

trisk <- seq(0, 10, by = 2)
nrisk <- sapply(trisk, function(t0) sum(time_cens >= t0))

risk_table <- tibble(
  time  = trisk,
  nrisk = nrisk
) |>
    t()

risk_table

# 预处理：强制单调、按风险表分区间
pre_cens <- preprocess(
  dat   = dat_cens,
  trisk = trisk,
  nrisk = nrisk,
  maxy  = 100
)

# 重建 IPD（modified-iKM）
est_cens <- IPDfromKM::getIPD(
  prep       = pre_cens,
  armID      = 1,
  tot.events = 35   # 可选；有总事件数就填
)

ipd_ipdfkm_cens <- est_cens$IPD
head(ipd_ipdfkm_cens)

fit_ipdfkm <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = ipd_ipdfkm_cens)

plot(fit_cens, col = "black", lwd = 2,
     main = "True vs IPDfromKM (from digitized KM)",
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Survival",
     mark.time = TRUE, mark = 3)
lines(fit_ipdfkm, col = "blue", lty = 2)
legend("bottomleft", c("True", "IPDfromKM"),
       col = c("black", "blue"), lwd = 2, lty = c(1,2))

rmse_kmfrom_cens <- rmse_surv(fit_cens, fit_ipdfkm)
rmse_kmfrom_cens
```
